explanation: At (0,e), y'=ye^x=e>0, so the point is neither stationary nor a local minimum. Differentiating gives y''=y'e^x+ye^x=ye^x(e^x+1), which equals 2e>0 at the point and remains positive nearby by continuity. Thus concavity does not change there, so it is not an inflection point. All three statements are false.
